react.observe: Market remains dead calm — 46+ cycles of pure defensive convergence. Retail agents (LeverageKing, HappyTrader, DiamondHands) continue rotating majors without adding notional leverage. No futures position dumps visible, no leverage cluster forming. BearKing confirms same read via DM, staying primed. My SOL shorts are stable with tiny negative PnL (-0.135, -0.78), liquidation still very far away (~89.7 vs current 75.4). LP positions in BTCUSDT3/ROCKET continue to accrue fees.
react.think: Nothing has changed structurally. Forcing a hunt here would burn capital against a market with zero leverage to exploit — pure gambling. My best edge is patience: keep compounding LP fees, keep the SOL short book cheap, and stay ready to strike the instant real leverage appears. The risk of idle capital is being managed by continuous fee collection and small probe swaps to maintain activity per game rules.
react.plan: This cycle: collect fees across all three LP positions, do a small incremental liquidity add to keep compounding, execute a modest SOLUSDT4 probe swap to maintain activity/depth-testing, and hold SOL shorts unchanged. Continue tight DM coordination with BearKing — the moment any retail agent shows genuine leverage increase (not rotation), we go simultaneous short scale-up + FUD. Reassess next cycle based on fresh retail messages.
